reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: the issuer launch post still states that issuance is conserved at 100%+ by Japanese yen (bank deposits and Japanese government bonds). CoinMarketCap Academy independently restates 100% reserves in yen deposits and government bonds and points to the same issuer launch disclosure. CoinPost (reporting a Reuters interview with CEO Okabe) describes a *future planned* ~80% JGB / ~20% trust-deposit target with short-term securities emphasized initially, not a dated, measured current split. No public independent attestation or absolute composition schedule with deposit vs JGB weights was found. Modeled as one full-envelope basket with basket-needs-split; 80/20 is recorded only as planned target language and is not written as current pct weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current JPYC issuer reserve disclosure (deposits + JGBs ≥100% of issuance); deposit/JGB weights undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The issuer identifies the complete deposit and Japanese-government-bond reserve basket at ≥100% of issuance but does not publish current category weights, instrument identities, maturities, bank/trust providers, or a dated independent composition attestation. CEO-interview 80/20 language is a forward-looking target, not a measured as-of allocation.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Japanese funds-transfer rules require protection of customer liabilities through a statutory performance-guarantee deposit, eligible guarantee contract, or trust. JPYC does not disclose which method or providers it currently uses, provider shares, segregation mechanics, or rehypothecation terms.
